faq: Which platforms can you move from?
Wix, WordPress, Squarespace, Webflow, Weebly and plain HTML are common starting points. Send your link and we confirm what moves cleanly and what we rebuild by hand.
Will I lose my Google rankings?
We cannot promise rankings. We copy titles and descriptions, keep page addresses where we can and set 301 redirects, which gives search engines the best chance to follow along.
Framer is built for content sites, so it is not a full store platform. Tell us what you sell and we can suggest a light payment-link setup or a better platform.
Should I cancel my old site right away?
No. Keep it running until the Framer site is approved and live. We tell you when it is safe to cancel so your domain and email do not break.

desc:
When you migrate your website to Framer, it is rebuilt there with your content, links and search titles carried over. Ecom Swift LLC moves sites from Wix, WordPress, Squarespace and other platforms into Framer, with redirects and a private preview before your domain switches.

## What is a website migration to Framer?

A website migration to Framer is the process of rebuilding an existing site inside Framer and moving it to the same web address. Pages, text, images and blog posts are copied across, laid out in Framer, and connected to the same domain once you approve.

The visitor should notice a better site, not a broken one. The hard part is invisible: keeping old addresses working, preserving titles and descriptions, and moving content in the right order.

## Why a careless move costs you

A site that moves without planning can lose its footing. Old addresses return error pages. Titles and descriptions vanish, so search results look different. Blog posts end up as images of text. Forms stop sending. Email stops working because someone changed the wrong DNS record.

Each of these is avoidable. A migration plan lists every page, decides what carries over and what retires, maps old addresses to new ones, and keeps the old site live until the new one is checked. That order of work is what separates a clean move from a messy one.

## How a good migration affects your results

People and search engines both depend on addresses. When the old links keep working through redirects, visitors who follow a saved bookmark or an old social post land on the right page. Copied titles and descriptions keep the same message in search results. Rankings can move after any migration and we cannot predict them, but careful redirects and preserved metadata remove the avoidable causes of loss.

The new platform brings its own gains. Framer pages can be easier to edit visually, and a CMS makes blog or portfolio entries simple to manage. A cleaner layout and lighter pages often make the site more pleasant to use on phones.

## What a careful migration includes

- An inventory of every page, post and image on the old site.
- Layouts rebuilt in Framer to match the current look or improve it.
- Images resized and compressed for the new site.
- Blog posts or portfolio entries imported into the Framer CMS.
- Page titles and descriptions copied from the old pages.
- A redirect map from old addresses to new ones.
- Forms rebuilt and tested with real submissions.
- A private preview for your review before launch.
- A domain switch plan that protects your email.
- A link check after launch.

## How we work

We start by listing the old site's pages and content, then agree with you what moves, what merges and what stays behind. We build the new pages in your Framer account, import the posts, and write the redirect map. You review the private preview and request changes.

Basic suits a small site of a few pages. Standard handles a mid-size site with a CMS blog, copied titles, rebuilt forms and a full redirect map. Premium covers a larger site, a bigger CMS import, a layout refresh with animation, domain and email checks, a link check after launch and a period of fixes.

We time the domain switch for you, and we advise you to keep the old plan active until you confirm that everything works.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Export or back up your old site before work starts.
- Tell us which pages matter most to your business.
- Keep your old site running until launch day.
- Check your email after the domain switch.
- Review the preview on a phone and a laptop.

**Avoid:**
- Cancelling the old hosting before the new site is live.
- Changing page addresses without redirects.
- Moving every outdated page just because it exists.
- Switching the domain without checking email records.
- Adding big design changes in the middle of the move.

## Who this is for

A business owner who has outgrown a template builder and wants a cleaner site is a common buyer. So is a freelancer moving a portfolio from WordPress to something simpler to edit, and a small team that wants a visual editor for its blog. We can move content-based sites. Online stores with checkout are a different job, and we will tell you plainly whether a store can move.

## What we need from you

Send the address of your current site, and invite us as a collaborator or staff user on the old platform, so we can read content and settings. Invite us to your Framer project too. We never ask for passwords.

Tell us where your domain and email are managed. Domain access can be shared through your registrar's own delegate or team feature.
